idnos.title: IDNO codes
idnos.description: Moldovan company IDNOs (13-digit state identification number, also the fiscal code), e.g. 1002600048836 (Moldtelecom). Spaces are ignored. Each IDNO returns one item; unknown IDNOs return an item with "found": false (not charged). Filters do not apply to IDNO lookups.

names.title: Company names
names.description: Company names or parts of names. Case-, diacritics- and Cyrillic-insensitive: "Stiinta", "Știința" and "ŞTIINŢA" all match. Legal-form words (SRL, S.R.L., SA, Î.I., ООО…) are ignored. Up to "Max results per name" best matches per name are returned.

nameMatch.title: Name matching
nameMatch.description: contains: every word you type appears in the company name. exact: the whole name equals your query (legal form ignored). fuzzy: also finds names with small typos.

fuzzyThreshold.title: Fuzzy similarity (%)
fuzzyThreshold.description: Only for fuzzy matching. Higher = stricter.

maxResults.title: Max results per name
maxResults.description: Maximum companies returned per name query, or in total for a filter-only search. Best matches first.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional. Narrows name searches, filter-only searches and exports. Keys: legalForms (e.g. ["SRL", "SA", "II"] or full Romanian names), statuses (["active", "liquidated", "in_process", "unknown", "other"]), registeredFrom / registeredTo (YYYY-MM-DD), activityCodes (CAEM prefixes, e.g. ["62", "47.19"]), location (text in the address, e.g. "Bălți" or "Ialoveni").

exportAll.title: Export the whole register
exportAll.description: Exports every company (optionally narrowed by Filters) instead of doing a lookup. Charged at the cheaper bulk price per company. Don't combine with IDNOs or names.

exportLimit.title: Export limit
exportLimit.description: Maximum companies to export. 0 = no limit.

includePeople.title: Include directors and founders
includePeople.description: Adds the lists of directors, founders (and beneficial owners if published) exactly as the state publishes them. Turn off for company-only data.

includeRawColumns.title: Include original columns
includeRawColumns.description: Adds a "raw" object with every column of the official file under its original Romanian header.

cacheMaxAgeHours.title: Re-check for a new official file after (hours)
cacheMaxAgeHours.description: The official file is downloaded once and cached in your account (key-value store "moldova-company-registry-cache"). After this many hours the Actor checks whether a newer file was published.

forceRefresh.title: Force fresh download
forceRefresh.description: Ignore the cache and download the official file again.

sourceFileUrl.title: Source file URL (override)
sourceFileUrl.description: Normally leave empty: the latest official file is found automatically on asp.gov.md and dataset.gov.md. Use this to point to a specific snapshot (XLSX or CSV), e.g. an older weekly file from dataset.gov.md.
